q: What do we know about feat-cld-risk-band-v2 in the limit-decrease-policy project?
a: feat-cld-risk-band-v2 (2025-10-28) rebuilds the four risk bands with the CLI utilisation slope and supersedes feat-cld-risk-band-v1. On cld-test-2025q3 the band rule's Gini rises from 0.41 to 0.47 (exp-206).

q: What came of exp-202, the notice-period test, in the limit-decrease-policy project?
a: exp-202 found a 30-day notice gave 3.1 complaints per 1,000 in 30 days against 4.6 for same-day notice, with no roll difference at 90 days. This led to dec-cld-notice-first on 2025-04-02.

q: What does cld-complaint-logit use as inputs in the limit-decrease-policy project?
a: cld-complaint-logit uses feat-cld-util-after-decrease (balance over the new limit for 60 days), feat-cld-complaint-flag (limit-related call flag) and tenure, trained on the ds-cld-complaint-calls labels.

q: What is the current risk-band decrease policy in the limit-decrease-policy project?
a: dec-cld-band-policy-2026 (2026-06-08): band C and D decreases of up to 25% per cycle, scored by cld-gbm-v3 on feat-cld-risk-band-v2, with the 640 score floor dropped. It supersedes the 2025 policy.

q: What AUC did cld-gbm-v3 reach on cld-test-2026q1 in the limit-decrease-policy project, and what did cld-gbm-v2 reach on the same set?
a: cld-gbm-v3 reached AUC 0.81 on cld-test-2026q1 (n=21,700 decreases from Jan-Mar 2026). cld-gbm-v2 reached 0.78 on the same set.

q: Why was the 2025 risk-band decrease policy replaced in the limit-decrease-policy project?
a: The 640 score floor drifted (PSI 0.22 between the 2025-Q4 and 2026-Q1 score pulls, find-cld-cut-640), and cld-gbm-v3 with payment-shock features added lift. dec-cld-band-policy-2026 therefore superseded dec-cld-band-policy-2025 on 2026-06-08.
